name: com.avanciq/connector
title: Avanciq - tax rates, codes, e-invoices, calculation checks
description: Official VAT rates, BR/MX/PL tax-code validity, EN 16931 e-invoice checks, exact sums for agents.

tools.name: coverage
tools.description: Free (0 calls). Lists what the other tools can answer: VAT/GST jurisdictions, official code tables per country with dates, e-invoice rulesets, and the calculation kinds with their exact input fields.

tools.name: vat_rate
tools.description: 1 call. Official VAT/GST/sales-tax rate for a country (EU 27, UK, CH, NO, IN, JP, SG, NZ, AE, Canada provinces, 22 US states) on a given date, with valid-from/to, official source link, the date we read it and a receipt id. Returns standard rate + reduced rates; it does not map products to reduced rates. Uncovered places answer status not_covered (never a guess).

country.description: ISO 3166 two-letter code, e.g. DE, FR, GB, IN, SG, CA, US. 'CA-QC' / 'US-TX' style also works.

region.description: Optional: Canadian province (ON, QC, BC, NS...) or US state (CA, TX, NY...). US answers are the state-level rate only, no local add-ons.

date.description: Optional: the date that matters (invoice/supply date) as YYYY-MM-DD. Default today.

tools.name: code_check
tools.description: 1 call per code. Checks whether an official code-list entry was in force on a date, from the authorities' own published files: Brazil NF-e (NCM, CFOP, cClassTrib, CST, CSOSN...), Mexico SAT CFDI 4.0 and 3.3 catalogs (c_UsoCFDI, c_ClaveProdServ, c_RegimenFiscal...), Poland KSeF FA(2)/FA(3) lists (TStawkaPodatku, TKodKraju, TGTU...). Answers status valid / expired / not_yet_valid / never_existed / not_covered with valid_from/valid_to, table version, source file link and receipt id. Send either one check (country, table, code, date) or 'checks' (list, max 100).

table.description: Official table name, e.g. ncm, cfop, cclasstrib, cst_icms (BR); c_UsoCFDI, c_ClaveProdServ, c_RegimenFiscal, c_ClaveUnidad (MX, add @3.3 for the CFDI 3.3 catalog); TStawkaPodatku, TKodKraju, TKodWaluty, TGTU (PL). The coverage tool lists all tables.

code.description: The code as written on the invoice; dots and spaces are ignored (8471.30.12 = 84713012).

date.description: The date that matters (issue date) as YYYY-MM-DD.

checks.description: Optional batch instead of the single fields: list of {country, table, code, date}.

tools.name: einvoice_check
tools.description: 2 calls. Runs the official CEN EN 16931 business rules (validation artefacts, unmodified) on a UBL 2.1 Invoice/CreditNote or UN/CEFACT CII (also the XML inside Factur-X/ZUGFeRD). Returns VALID/INVALID, each failed rule id with where it fails and how to fix it. XML is checked in memory, not stored.

xml.description: The complete invoice XML document as text.

ruleset.description: Optional; auto detects UBL vs CII.

tools.name: einvoice_rule
tools.description: Free (0 calls). Official text and fix hint for one EN 16931 business rule id, e.g. BR-CO-15.

rule_id.description: Rule id like BR-CO-15, BR-S-08, BR-01.

tools.name: verify_calculation
tools.description: 1 call. Recomputes a business calculation exactly (decimal, stated rounding) and says whether a claimed result is correct: invoice/claim totals with discounts and shipping, GST/VAT invoices, loan interest and amortisation, depreciation, FX with markup and fees, FIFO / moving-average inventory, weekly payroll overtime, trade quotes. Input fields per kind are listed by the coverage tool.

inputs.description: The numbers, e.g. loan_interest {principal, annual_rate_percent, days, day_count 365|360}; invoice_or_claim_total {lines[{quantity, unit_price, discount_percent?}], invoice_discount_percent?, shipping?, tax_rate_percent?, tax_on_shipping?, amount_paid?}. Full field list per kind: coverage.

claimed_result.description: Optional: the single number to check, e.g. 49.32.

claimed_results.description: Optional: several named numbers to check, e.g. {"interest": 49.32, "total": 10049.32}.
